verdict.rationale: Consensus is an AI research search engine, and such a product could plausibly offer event-triggered rules (for example, alerts that fire when new papers match a query), so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a REST API and MCP server for running searches on demand and a research agent that chains search tools. Neither is a user-defined rule that triggers actions automatically on events. API-driven automated searches are a developer building block, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
